title: Feature Request: MyFitnessPal Integration
body: Ideally xDrip should integrate with popular nutrition apps to pull in carb data automatically since the predictive low algorithm needs carb information. I am suggesting MyFitnessPal since it is one of the more popular options that works regardless of phone manufacturer and even works if someone happens to enter something on an iOS device. This is especially important for users with a looping setup since they are more likely to properly enter carbs if it is easy for them to do so.

comments.body: @definitivequestion What would be the outcome for someone who uses a language different than the language supported in that app?
